I find comfort in patterns when they appear in art or music, but numbers often feel foreign and intimidating to me.

replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I have not used AI to support my math learning in the past year. To find stationary points, I would take the derivative of the function f(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Then, I would check the second derivative to see if the point is a maximum, minimum, or neither. I would say this helps identify where the slope is flat, like the top or bottom of a curve.
